newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi offers bonds worth two billion riyals.
newsitem.headline: Saudi offers bonds worth two billion riyals.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has offered four- and five-year government bonds worth two billion riyals to local banks, a banker said on Monday.
He said the bonds were offered by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency on Saturday for settlement on Wednesday.
The coupon for four-year bonds, maturing on January 15, 2001 and worth one billion riyals, was put at 6.6795 percent. They were priced at 99.99010.
The coupon for five-year bonds worth one billion riyals and maturing on January 15, 2002, was put at 6.8515 percent. They were priced at 100.10330.
